state.audienceAndPurpose: Write a client update to Avery explaining the launch position, keeping confidence in the team, and requesting the action needed next.
state.deliverable:
Hi Avery,

We can still deliver the October 8 staging demo using synthetic data. However, production launch is blocked until Nia completes the security review, which now concludes October 12 at the earliest. The team is fully prepared and remains confident in the quality of the release. Once Nia delivers the review, we will evaluate the results; any required remediation will follow.

You need to decide whether to accept the October 8 staging demo as planned.

We remain committed to launching as soon as we secure the proper approvals. No new production date is authorized until we complete the security review.
